Products

Each bill line is matched to this list to get the item code. Case size = pieces per case; it splits Qty into Cases and Loose (0 = everything Loose). Bill names are how the invoice prints the item, plus spellings learned when you confirm bills.

Customers

The name printed after “Customer :” on the bill is used. This list only fixes spelling when the print is faint or cut off. New customers are added when you confirm a bill.
